commit_message: Test managed Go integrity worker boundary
pr_title: Fix Managed Local AI UI worker boundaries
pr_body:
## Summary

- carry one frozen Managed Local resource config through Managed Play capability planning and transition startup instead of resolving it twice
- retain ADR 0155 Enforced verification on the model-resource and native model-turn workers inherited from #909
- explicitly test that both WindowsNative and Wsl2Linux Managed Local model turns and Release/Reload resource work start without inline integrity verification and report integrity failures from their workers

## Scope

This PR intentionally does not recreate the separate Send, GPU-layer, inference-error, or benchmark-campaign work in #909. It is stacked on #909 and contains only the remaining UI-thread/resource-transition work plus worker-boundary regression coverage.

No presentation/layout behavior changes; Visual Validation is not requested.
